FAQ

Straight answers.

Is the credit repair really included?
Yes. Done-for-you credit repair is included with your membership at no extra charge. Your membership pays for the education, community, and funding playbook, and we handle your disputes as part of it.
How does the 10% funding fee work?
If you secure funding through our process, a 10% success fee applies to the amount you're approved for. Get $20,000 and the fee is $2,000. If you don't get funded through our process, you don't owe it. It's spelled out in your written agreement before you begin.
How long does credit repair take?
It depends on your reports. Bureaus generally have about 30 days to investigate each dispute, and most files need more than one round. Some members see changes within the first month or two; others take longer. We'll be honest with you about your file and won't make promises we can't keep.
Do I need good credit to start?
No. That's the whole point. Whether your credit is bad, thin, or nonexistent, the framework starts exactly where you are.
What happens in the community?
Live sessions, Q&A, step-by-step walkthroughs of each phase, wins and lessons from other members, and accountability so you actually follow through.
Can I cancel?
[Confirm your policy, e.g. "Yes. Cancel your membership anytime from your account; you won't be billed again."] For credit repair services, you also have the right to cancel within 3 business days of signing, without penalty, as required by federal law.

Credit repair disclosures (Credit Repair Organizations Act)

You have the right to dispute inaccurate information in your credit report by contacting the credit bureaus directly, at no cost. Neither you nor any credit repair company has the right to have accurate, current, and verifiable information removed from your credit report. You have the right to obtain a copy of your credit report from each bureau, and free reports are available at AnnualCreditReport.com. You may cancel a credit repair services contract without penalty or obligation within 3 business days of signing it. A written contract and the full "Consumer Credit File Rights Under State and Federal Law" disclosure will be provided before any credit repair services begin.

Funding

Funding approval, amounts, and terms are determined solely by third-party lenders. A 10% success fee applies only when funding is secured through our process, as described in your written agreement.
